description.narrative:
The project “Making nature and deforestation material to financial decision-making” is implemented by The Taskforce on Nature-related Financial Disclosures (TNFD).
The TNFD Secretariat is administratively supported by the Green Finance Institute (GFI). TNFD is the main reporting framework for assessing companies' impacts and dependencies on nature, enhancing private sector actors' knowledge and awareness regarding their reliance on nature for financial returns.
The project will contribute to reducing and reversing loss of tropical forests through strengthening the ability of companies and financial institutions with high dependency on natural assets and exposure to deforestation to identify, manage and mitigate these risks via their financial decision making.
The project supports the development of nature-related standards for reporting, for companies and financial institutions to understand their impact on nature and potentially influence their decision-making and shift their investments away from the destruction of nature and tropical forests.
The project’s main objectives are: - Impact: Scaling market adoption of TNFD guidance to make nature and deforestation material to financial decision-making. - Outcome 1: Nature standards for corporate disclosures are aligned with TNFD - Outcome 2: Financial institutions and companies are adopting TNFD recommendations on a voluntary basis - Outcome 3: Increased market confidence and commitment to take action on nature and deforestation - Outcome 4: Improved access to nature-related data
